items.title: Jimmy Heath — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I remember Pastor Berry used to kick Miles’ butt.

ctx.x: Get it from the book, the book.

Yeah, cause why didn’t somebody write a book? That made me so mad! Why don’t you write a book about Milt Jackson, one of the most talented musicians ever? I guess he’s number ten, he ain’t number one; Miles is number one! (Laughs) I remember Pastor Berry used to kick Miles’ butt.

I guess one thing we should touch on is, we are here over the next few days celebrating the NEA Jazz Masters, and this 2010 crop of Jazz Masters. You were named an NEA Jazz Master in 2003, so you have been part of this group for some years now, and you have attended some of these events celebrating the Jazz Masters. Can you describe the experience of having that title given to you and being part of that group?
